title: Random Variable and Distribution
notes: **Random Variable and Distribution:** This topic covers the fundamental concepts of random variable and distribution in the mathematics curriculum.
Understanding random variable and distribution is essential for solving problems and building higher-level mathematical skills.
Key definitions and theorems related to random variable and distribution should be memorized and practiced regularly.

Practice with multiple examples to solidify your understanding.

Try to derive the key formulas from first principles.
Create a summary sheet with all important formulas and theorems.
